profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Panasonic Avionics Corporation
profile.summary:
Skills and Knowledge
• Meeting business requirements with customer-centric technical solutions
• Experience working with stakeholders outside the team, such as operations, vendors and partners
• Programming in C, C++, MPI, Python, Bash. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, PHP, SQL, Java
• System software for high performance computer architectures including distributed systems with high bandwidth, high throughput, and low latency requirements
• Linux User/Kernel space development, concurrency, scheduling, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP
• Strong software debugging skills. Performance analysis, and test-driven development
• Continuous integration environment, Agile software development, object-oriented design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Firmware and Software for flight entertainment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivering large scale commercial software in C++ for 3D modeling.

positions.title: Library Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Test-driven development of graphics API library in C++11 for writing applications to execute across heterogeneous platforms.
• Design and implement GPU performance benchmarks, GPU sample applications, unit tests and integration tests.
• Analyze GPU Performance across hardware and software stack.
• Technologies: OpenCL, SYCL, CUDA, GPU architecture, google tests, C++11, cmake, clang
• Prior work entailed developing high performance libraries to work in tandem with network interface cards.

positions.title: Network Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop Linux device drivers for large NUMA systems with high bandwidth and low latency network interconnects (Infiniband).
• Open source contributor for Linux Infiniband subsystem for Intel Omni Path Architecture (OPA) Fabric.
• Measure, analyze, and eliminate performance bottlenecks.
• Develop and support tools written in Python and C.
• Technologies: TCP/IP, Infiniband, RDMA, PCIe interconnects, MPI, Jenkins, Gerrit.
• Specific Accomplishments:
- Made driver code optimizations that improved message rate to meet product requirements.
- Balanced MPI application work-load by simplifying user process and IRQ affinity
for multi-NUMA node systems.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Involved in all phases of development of motion control and sensor calibration firmware code for printer engines on ThreadX and embedded Linux using the C language.
• Firmware feature lead for failure analysis EEPROM with I2C protocol. Responsible for gathering, designing, implementing, and testing requirements.
• Liaison between firmware and serviceability/operations teams to clarify and implement functionality for manufacturing testing process and customer experience.
• Porting code from previous products. Maintaining and extending functionality for team's tools in C and C++.
• Creating and maintaining documentation on my work.
• Specific Accomplishments:
    Modified in-house language compiler to add static analysis to it.
